---
title: "Tracks"
---

```{r}
source("_setup.R")
tags <- read_fig_csv("track_tags.csv") %>% filter(n_stations >= 2) %>% arrange(desc(n_stations), desc(track_km))
```

{{< include _sample_warning.qmd >}}

A **stop** is a run of detections at one station. Lines join a tag's stops in time
order; they are straight lines between receivers, not flight paths. Points are coloured
by arrival date and sized by how long the bird stayed.

## Every tag seen at two or more stations

![](figures/track_overview.png)

## One tag at a time

```{r}
#| output: asis
opts <- sprintf('<option value="figures/track_tag%d.html">%d %s — %d stations, %s to %s, ~%s km</option>',
                tags$motusTagID, tags$motusTagID, tags$species, tags$n_stations,
                substr(tags$first, 1, 10), substr(tags$last, 1, 10), format(tags$track_km, big.mark = ","))
cat('<p><label for="tagpick"><b>Tag:</b></label> <select id="tagpick" onchange="document.getElementById(\'trackframe\').src=this.value" style="max-width:100%">',
    paste(opts, collapse = "\n"), '</select></p>',
    sprintf('<iframe id="trackframe" src="figures/track_tag%d.html" style="width:100%%;height:600px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px"></iframe>',
            tags$motusTagID[1]), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
tags %>% transmute(Tag = motusTagID, Species = species, Stops = n_stops, Stations = n_stations,
                   First = substr(first, 1, 10), Last = substr(last, 1, 10), `Track (km)` = track_km) %>%
  kable()
```
